note: No individual creator was relied upon as a recommender for Brussels. Every place is sourced to credible native/institutional editorial (visit.brussels, RTBF, BX1, La Libre, Le Soir, L'Avenir, Le Vif, Michelin, Gault&Millau, UNESCO, official museum/brewery/municipal sites) or a named authoritative critic (Gilles Pudlowski). Food-tour/blog leads (doeatbetterexperience, candaceabroad, Paola Everywhere) were used only to discover candidates, then cross-checked and cited against credible outlets — never as a lone pin. Add a verified, verifiably-popular BE creator here only if one is ever used as a corroborating source with a specific findable piece.
